mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may cause hypokalemia and hyperuricemia, while dutasteride has minimal direct interaction; however, electrolyte abnormalities from thiazide diuretics can theoretically affect drug metabolism and efficacy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes and uric acid levels periodically; no dose adjustment needed but counsel patients on adequate potassium intake or consider potassium-sparing agent if hypokalemia develops.
